propositions: Merge-abort recovery toolkit is duplicated across sync.reconverge and push_recovery, with divergence in the untracked-path quarantine mover: push_recovery verifies git status ?? before moving, but sync.reconverge and doctor._quarantine_leftovers do not.
The quarantine mover must accept git as a callable parameter to work with both sync's module-level _git and push_recovery's late-bound core._git seam without losing monkeypatch points.

Consolidate duplicated functions (abort_named_paths, untracked_overwrite_paths, local_change_paths, quarantine_dir_under, quarantine_untracked, restore_local_changes) into a single owned merge_recovery.py module with strict uniqueness guards and no re-implementation.

Both sync.py and push_recovery.py must retain their original function names as thin delegating adapters to preserve existing monkeypatch sites and test bindings while eliminating the implementation duplication.
